0261cd0f-e763-49b5-96ed-5e5767a3d8d7.flavorText: Fire Elementals are ruthless infernos, annihilating and consuming their foes in a frenzied holocaust. Crackling and blazing, they sear swift, terrible paths, leaving the land charred and scorched in their wake.

11bf2cc0-799f-4eb8-b338-ed7543f469e7.name: Gray Ogre
11bf2cc0-799f-4eb8-b338-ed7543f469e7.flavorText: The Ogre philosopher Gnerdel believed the purpose of life was to live as high on the food chain as possible. She refused to eat vegetarians, preferring to live entirely on creatures that preyed on sentient beings.

38fc72de-2093-477b-b39e-696339d2fdbc.name: Grizzly Bears
38fc72de-2093-477b-b39e-696339d2fdbc.flavorText: Don't try to outrun one of Dominia's Grizzlies; it'll catch you, knock you down, and eat you. Of course, you could run up a tree. In that case you'll get a nice view before it knocks the tree down and eats you.
